episodes.synopsis: Cid and his sister Claire venture to the huge slum known as the “Lawless City.” There, Cid gets caught up in the commotion caused by the Red Moon.
episodes.title: The Lawless City

episodes.synopsis: The moon is red. The frenzy has begun. Shadow is introduced to power players in Lawless City. Meanwhile, Mary and Claire run into Juggernaut.
episodes.title: The Haven

episodes.synopsis: The night the red moon rises, the Blood Queen Elisabeth makes her return.
episodes.title: The Hour of Awakening

episodes.synopsis: The Mitsugoshi Company is doing great, all thanks to Gamma! However, the biggest crisis imaginable rears its ugly head.
episodes.title: Mask of Falsehood

episodes.synopsis: Alpha and Gamma carefully plot not take any actions that would implicate Mitsugoshi's connection to Shadow Garden. Meanwhile, John Smith has a plot of his own.
episodes.title: He Who Pulls the Strings

episodes.synopsis: John Smith's skill is leagues above even the most skilled fighters! Who is this mysterious person?
episodes.title: John Smith

episodes.synopsis: The Major Corporate Alliance has forced closure of all their storefronts, bringing the citizens' unrest to its peak. But can Shadow Garden weather the storm?
episodes.title: Something Precious

episodes.synopsis: With Cid missing and things getting hot, the Shadow Garden springs into action. At the Mitsugoshi Hot Springs Land that is!
episodes.title: The Dragon’s Tears

episodes.synopsis: On the way to the Kingdom of Oriana, Cid is also on a journey of self-discovery and reflection. He feels like something's missing. Is he imagining it?
episodes.title: The Key

episodes.synopsis: Did Princess Rose Oriana take it upon herself to join up with the enemy? Not even the Seven Shadows have authority over this matter anymore.
episodes.title: Caged Bird

episodes.synopsis: With Princess Rose’s hands tied as Perv has taken her mother hostage, the Eminence in Shadow must move to free the captive himself.
episodes.title: Determination

episodes.synopsis: Let the banquet of slaughter begin in the season finale.
episodes.title: HIGHEST
